messages:
jing: Heads-up — we ran into a routing edge where EU-tier-standard traffic gets routed to a quantized variant that doesn't support tool_calling in 2 of our models. Seen a few customer errors and a spike in telemetry.
sam: Ah that's the variant parity problem again. Are we sure router is matching by 'model_id' only and not checking capability set?
jing: Router currently matches model family + region + tier. It falls back to any compatible variant we list in fallback_groups. No capability gating today.
priya: Can you paste the error payload?
jing: Error: "tool_calling not implemented for variant xq-8k-q4." stack trace minimal. Customer request included a tool call with structured args.
adrian: So mismatch types: tokenizer differences (bpesplit vs spm), context limit mismatch (8k vs 4k effective due to kv sharding), and tool-calling API parity. We need a compatibility matrix to gate fallbacks.
sam: Agreed. Minimal matrix prototype:
```
model_family | variant | tokenizer | max_ctx | tool_calling
base-llama   | fp16    | bpe       | 8192    | yes
base-llama   | q4_8k   | bpe       | 4096    | no
other-model  | q8      | spm       | 8192    | yes
```
We should enrich with known behavioral deltas.
priya: Router should have a capability predicate like: supports_tool_calling==true AND tokenizer_compat==true AND effective_ctx>=req_ctx. If predicate fails, try next candidate or return 429 if none.
infra-bot: Note: this will change routing performance slightly — extra predicate checks add a microsecond but ok for correctness. :thumbsup:
adrian: Console UX: when a route falls back for capability reasons, show clear breadcrumb + reason and allow one-click override (for customers with opt-in risk). Also telemetry: tag these as "capability_fallback" for chain-level analytics.
sam: For rollout UX we need experiments — canary with 5% traffic where fallback gating is ON vs OFF. Release-bot can we schedule a canary for prod tomorrow?
release-bot: Canary scheduled for 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC on group "eu-tier" 5% traffic, window 1h. Rolling back automatically on error-rate > 1.0%
priya: Action items: (1) design capability schema for variants in model-catalog (tokenizer, max_ctx_effective, tool_calling boolean), (2) router predicate implementation, (3) console telemetry + UX flag, (4) rollout plan + canary. I'll own 1+2.
jing: I'll file the infra ticket and add a quick migration to populate catalog for the affected families.
adrian: Also add a test harness case: synthetic request with tool call + long prompt -> ensure no silent degrade.
sam: One more: add a warning in SDK when a request includes tool_calling with a variant known to not support it — bail early with descriptive error.
priya: Sounds good. tagging :eyes: for follow-ups. I'll draft the compatibility matrix format and drop in #eng-platform-docs.
